english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for an ecological system made up of organisms and their environment.
Use this when the ecology is viewed specifically as an interconnected system of organisms and their environment.

examples.english: This wetland's ecosystem is very fragile.
examples.traditional: 呢個濕地嘅生態系統好脆弱。
